name: ps-import-module-parameter-binding
body: import_module binds Import-Module parameters left to right as the grammar yields them: a value-taking parameter directly followed by another parameter binds nothing (so -Prefix -Force X leaves X positional), a parameter given twice keeps its first value, and of -ModuleInfo and -Assembly the first in source wins. Limit: PowerShell refuses each of these invocations, while the scan still derives a site from them. Upgrade by reporting such invocations as computed or as diagnostics when real scripts rely on them.
